title: Field Service & Pre-Harvest Checklist

expressions.expr: The autosteer keeps the tractor perfectly on line
expressions.meaning: O piloto automático mantém o trator perfeitamente na linha
expressions.example: We tested it: the autosteer keeps the tractor perfectly on line.

expressions.expr: Let's do a test drive in the field
expressions.meaning: Vamos fazer um teste na lavoura
expressions.example: The installation is finished. Let's do a test drive in the field.

expressions.expr: I trained the operator on the new display
expressions.meaning: Treinei o operador no monitor novo
expressions.example: I trained the operator on the new display for thirty minutes.

expressions.expr: Everything is all set for the harvest
expressions.meaning: Está tudo pronto para a colheita
expressions.example: We finished the checklist. Everything is all set for the harvest!

sentences: We arrived at the farm early for the pre-harvest check.
First, we inspected the antenna bracket on the roof.
Then we checked the steering valve and the cables.
We calibrated the autosteer in a flat field.
The autosteer keeps the tractor perfectly on line.
I trained the operator on how to set the A-B line.
The customer signed the service report.
Everything is all set for the harvest season.

grammar.title: Let's + verbo e How to + verbo: conduzindo o teste com o operador
rules: Use "Let's + verbo base" para convidar o cliente ou operador a testar junto: "Let's turn it on together." / "Let's do a test drive."
Use "how to + verbo base" para ensinar procedimentos no monitor: "I showed him how to set the A-B line."
Mais exemplos práticos: "how to save the boundary" (como salvar a bordadura), "how to load the map" (como carregar o mapa).
Feche a visita com "Everything is all set!" (Está tudo pronto/configurado!).
